title: This product did NOT work for me!!!
text:
This product did NOT work for me!!!. [[VIDEOID:6ef2fc1bac40d73870d11e5470cfee3a]] I found this product to be a risk. It slides way to easy on a linoleum floor. Unfortunately, this is the area I want to use this. Like in my kitchen and bathroom. The rubber feet are way to small to keep it from sliding. I found this product to be a risk for me and anyone in the family. You can guess where I put it!

Trust you found this review honest and helpful!!!
